title: Playing at the Lyric Theater with John Robichaud
summary: Bigard played a good while at the Lyric Theater with Robichaud, so he joined Robichaud's band when it formed. The interviewer asks where he went after the Brown Derby.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Because I formed a player at the Lyric Theater, a really good while, with John Roebichaud. That's why when he formed his band, I went with him.
That's where you went to play at the Lyric with John. Where did you go after the Brown Derby?
